moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-trim-path, written here): pathLength = 1, stroke-dasharray 0.22 1; dashoffset 0.22 -> -1, so a 22 % window enters at the start and leaves past the end, 900 ms easeInOutCubic; faint full guide path under it. Demo 2.2 s: run between 10 % and 84 %. Site card (sh-trim): trim paths on a circle r 50, 8 px round cap: end 0 -> 1 over 0.2-0.9 s, start follows over 0.45-1.2 s, ease-in-out. Params: length: độ dài vệt (0.22) · duration (0.9 s) · ease (power2.inOut).
